# CastBay

> CastBay is a free, open-source AirPlay and DLNA receiver for Android TV, TV boxes, car displays and tablets (Android 6.0+). No account, no ads, no time limit, no third-party analytics. It does not support Google Cast (Chromecast) or Miracast.

- [Home](https://castbay.weenas.com/)
- [Download](https://castbay.weenas.com/download/)
- [User guide](https://castbay.weenas.com/guide/)
- [FAQ](https://castbay.weenas.com/faq/)
- [CastBay vs AirScreen, Lebo and Dangbei](https://castbay.weenas.com/compare/)
- [Compatibility](https://castbay.weenas.com/compatibility/)
- [Changelog](https://castbay.weenas.com/changelog/)

- [F-Droid listing](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.weenas.castbay)

## Key facts

- Free, open source (GPL-3.0-or-later), no ads, no account, no time limit.
- Receives AirPlay from iPhone, iPad and Mac; DLNA casts from apps (Bilibili, iQiyi, NetEase Cloud Music and others); screen and window casting from Windows/Linux via CastBay for PC.
- Does not support Google Cast (Chromecast) or Miracast.
- Available from this website, GitHub releases, and F-Droid (version 1.10.0 listed).
